findings: The original live dyad gives the independent caps 14 L_i, distinct from the 7 L_i full primal caps. It forces E1 Nh < 14 and leaves only bounded r, e0 and e1. The w projector precedes stripping with w squarefree and prime to d,r,e0. The raw phase psi(w)^2 is preserved. No w or r exclusion is inserted on the partner frequency. The separate row-independent frequency weight is the exact scope needed for the three-array factorization.

The fourth moments square the formed sextic sums and group actual product ideals. The frequency product uses the inherited all-ideal extension with separate S and sixth-power frozen factors and their raw zeros. No cubic comparison is used on generic exponent-two products.

Equality supremum with the two cutoff masses and the frequency mass gives R/E times sqrt(T/R), up to the stated physical moment ratios and harmonic w cost. The maximum combined cutoff losses are 5/48,13/192,1/32 in the three stated divisor ranges. On 3/8 <= t <= 45/88 the needed Delta6(2t) term is 5t/3-1/2. The thresholds are 19/44,83/176,45/88 and smaller t follows by monotonicity.

The exact middle compensation is still the elementary equality R/E bound with the same selected frequency weight of modulus at most one, only on the original middle window. The proof does not apply the full-frequency primal unit collapse to a mode selection.
limitation: Acceptance is for separately selected low partner frequency terms, not coupled defect selectors, high frequencies or the whole signed form.
